item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 01/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Showers and thunderstorms triggered by high temperatures will continue to affect Guangdong today. Under the influence of a dry continental airstream and the outer subsiding air of Super Typhoon Hinnamnor, it will be generally fine and persistently very hot over southeastern China towards the weekend and early next week. A broad trough of low pressure is expected to bring showers to the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea in the middle and latter parts of next week. Besides, Hinnamnor will move across the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days.

Wind: North force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier in some areas during the day, and it will be hot with sunny intervals. Some haze.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium
